text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Mideast Summit in Washington a failure according to PLO but a success according to Israel.
- Retired laywer C.J. Koh gives Singapore $2 million to Singapore Universities Endowment Fund.
- Singapore Health Minister George Yeo asks Parliament to express regret at Singapore Democratic Party's attempts to mislead House and public.
- Amcol Holdings' joint-venture partner in Mauritius agrees to buy back Amcol's stake in the aborted property deal on the Indian Ocean island.
- Property will be the core business of the newly renamed Golden Amcol under parent Sinar Mas group.
- Property consultants say private residential property prices slipped an overall 5 percent during the third quarter.
- Power utility Singapore Power is to maximise returns on capital and assets and study feasibility of importing electric cars.
- National Science & Technology Board is keen to promote perepheral industry to support electric vehicle.
- Marco Polo Developments Ltd brings forward launch of last 100 units of Ardmore Park condominium project to middle of next month.
- Royal Brothers to redevelop the Melia at Scotts hotel into condominium.
- First Capital Corporation makes first major move into London property market by acquiring substantial stake in London-listed Benchmark Group plc.
- Pacific Andes Holding's initial public offer at U.S. 57 cents attracts lukewarm response.
- Oil and petrochemicals trader Sinochem Asia looks set for listing in Singapore.
- Transmarco offer gets 0.08 percent acceptance by shareholders, so Sampoerna now owns 65.85 percent in firm.
